title: OpenAI Invests Heavily in Extravagant Summer Camp to Cater to Influencers, $2000 per Night Sparks Back-to-Future Criticism

content_html:
OpenAI invited a group of influencers to the luxury resort Wildflower Farms in the Hudson Valley, New York. During the past weekend, many content creators have already shared videos of that "summer camp" on social media platforms. The 140-acre estate, which usually costs over $2,000 per night for a weekend stay, is shaded by trees, with warm, tavern-style lighting illuminating a long wooden table that can seat about 30 people. At the end of the table, the OpenAI logo glowed softly, turning the entire dinner into a brand promotional video.

According to the content released by the participants, the schedule was very "rural": eating, attending classes on OpenAI's latest tools, doing outdoor activities, and even participating in an experience with a beekeeper. Everyone left with a canvas bag and a jar of honey featuring the OpenAI logo. OpenAI told Business Insider that this was an educational event related to its recently launched ChatGPT Work, and it was part of a larger plan to promote the practical applications of its products through creators.

However, the idyllic scene quickly backfired. On social media, there were overwhelming criticisms: How could a company that operates multiple high-energy, high-water consumption data centers afford to flatter influencers at a nature-themed resort? A Reddit user wrote, "This is the correct use of the word 'dystopia'." More people on X, Reddit, TikTok, and Instagram accused OpenAI of "greenwashing"—using marketing to cover up its environmentally unfriendly reality. Others criticized the creators for not mentioning the environmental cost of the technology when they were promoting AI. Journalist Taylor Lorenz pointed out on X that the participants were being collectively boycotted.

Business Insider tried to contact several creators, but none responded to comments. OpenAI also refused to explain whether the attendees received payment, who covered their travel and accommodation, or if they were required to post. Grace McCarrick, an influencer, did speak openly in a video: "My moral standards were not crossed, and I am extremely excited about AI and the opportunities it brings to humanity. That's it."

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 邀请了一群有影响力的人来到纽约哈德逊河谷的豪华度假胜地野花农场。 刚刚过去的周末，不少内容创作者已经在社交媒体平台上分享了那次“夏令营”的视频。 这座占地 140 英亩的庄园周末住宿费用通常每晚超过 2,000 美元，周围绿树成荫，温暖的酒馆风格灯光照亮了一张可容纳约 30 人的长木桌。 餐桌尽头，OpenAI标志柔和发光，将整场晚宴变成了品牌宣传视频。

根据参与者发布的内容，日程安排非常“田园”：吃饭、参加 OpenAI 最新工具的课程、进行户外活动，甚至参加与养蜂人的体验。 每个人都留下了一个帆布袋和一罐带有 OpenAI 标志的蜂蜜。 OpenAI 告诉 Business Insider，这是与其最近推出的 ChatGPT Work 相关的教育活动，也是通过创作者推广其产品实际应用的更大计划的一部分。

然而，美好的景象很快就产生了事与愿违的效果。 社交媒体上，批评声铺天盖地：一家运营着多个高能耗、高耗水数据中心的公司怎么能在自然主题度假村里奉承有影响力的人呢？ 一位 Reddit 用户写道：“这是‘反乌托邦’这个词的正确用法。” X、Reddit、TikTok 和 Instagram 上越来越多的人指责 OpenAI 进行“绿色清洗”——利用营销来掩盖其不环保的现实。 还有人批评创造者在推广人工智能时没有提及该技术的环境成本。 记者泰勒·洛伦茨（Taylor Lorenz）在X上指出，参与者遭到集体抵制。

《商业内幕》试图联系几位创作者，但无人回复评论。 OpenAI 还拒绝解释与会者是否收到了付款、谁承担了他们的旅行和住宿费用，或者他们是否被要求发帖。 有影响力的格蕾丝·麦卡里克(Grace McCarrick)确实在视频中公开表示：“我的道德标准没有被超越，我对人工智能及其给人类带来的机会感到非常兴奋。 就是这样。”
